remarks: Welcome home to 14 Windward Avenue, your beautifully updated four-bedroom, two-bath home with an office/flexspace room in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods. This warm, modern residence features a completely remodeled interior with new flooring, freshly painted interior and exterior , refinished hardwood floors, all-new kitchen appliances, resurfaced cabinetry and countertops, and contemporary lighting throughout. A brand-new A/C unit adds comfort and efficiency, while both bathrooms have been thoughtfully updated with new finishes and fixtures. The rebuilt three-season room offers a bright and versatile space for work, relaxation, or entertainment. Outside, the property has been freshly landscaped, creating inviting curb appeal. This home is truly move-in ready.  Perfectly situated near the SONO Arts District, major shopping, dining, and daily conveniences, this location offers unmatched accessibility. Commuters will appreciate the easy access to I-95, the Route 7 Connector, and the South Norwalk train station, providing seamless travel to Stamford, Bridgeport, and New York City. Modern comfort, thoughtful updates, and a prime location 14 Windward Avenue has it all.
